summary: Mature, MIT, provenance-signed headless primitives with the smallest dialog bundle in the batch (235.03 KB / 74.66 KB gzip). It is held because the unified package installs 76 packages, and Radix has narrower coverage of complex widgets such as date/time, data tables and internationalized collections. Use it only for an existing Radix codebase or a focused dialog/menu surface.
reasoning: Active release line: 1.8.1 published 2026-10-12; repository pushed 2026-10-14; 19k stars and 265 open issues.
MIT with a permissive tree and no required CSS runtime.
npm provenance is present via GitHub Actions trusted publishing.
No install scripts and no recorded OSV advisories.
The React 19 dialog spike rendered role=dialog, labelledby, describedby and focus inside.
The dialog bundle was the smallest in the batch: 235.03 KB / 74.66 KB gzip.
The unified radix-ui package lists 55 primitive dependencies and installs 76 packages / about 16 MB. Individual @radix-ui/react-* packages are smaller and are the right choice if Radix is used.
Radix is excellent for dialogs, menus, popovers, tabs and form controls, but it is not the broadest option for data tables, date/time and internationalization.
caveats: The unified radix-ui package installs the full primitive suite even if only one component is used. Prefer individual @radix-ui/react-* packages.
Narrower coverage than React Aria for complex widgets.
No local spike for tables, date/time or drag-and-drop.
Radix is mature and stable, but the decision prefers React Aria for a greenfield design-system foundation.

evidence.label: License
evidence.detail: MIT; the isolated tree is MIT and 0BSD only.

evidence.label: React compatibility
evidence.detail: peerDependencies react/react-dom: ^16.8 || ^17.0 || ^18.0 || ^19.0. The spike used React 19.2.0.

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: 55 runtime dependencies in the unified package; 76 packages / about 16 MB installed with React 19. Individual primitives are smaller.

evidence.label: Install scripts
evidence.detail: No preinstall, install or postinstall script in the isolated tree.

evidence.label: Known advisories
evidence.detail: OSV returned no advisories for radix-ui@1.8.1 and @radix-ui/react-dialog@1.3.1.

evidence.label: npm provenance
evidence.detail: SLSA provenance is present on 1.8.1; npm records GitHub Actions as the publisher via a trusted publisher.

evidence.label: React browser spike
evidence.detail: A Vite production build rendered an open dialog in Chrome 1200x800 with role=dialog, labelledby, describedby and focus inside. The JS bundle was 235.03 KB / 74.66 KB gzip including React 19.

evidence.label: Component coverage
evidence.detail: Strong core primitives, but narrower coverage of complex tables, date/time and internationalized collections than React Aria.
